svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: What did separate the conditions: output tokens
svg.desc: A horizontal bar chart of total output tokens across the 15 tasks. Without the plugin: 3,671 tokens. With the plugin: 10,337 tokens, 2.8 times as many. Two further figures sit beside the bars: the median per-task ratio is 3.9 times, and the widest single task went from 23 tokens to 407, 17.7 times. The footer notes that the extra tokens bought identically scored code on 14 of 15 tasks and literally the same code on 5. These are the language model's output tokens, not a measurement of q or KDB-X.
svg.text: Same scores. About three times the output tokens.
